chunks: Surely the punishment of his Lord is not secure
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the punishment of the Lord is not secure?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Ma'arij underscores the dynamic nature of divine retribution, reminding believers that security from punishment is never guaranteed until the final accounting. It serves as a spiritual motivator for continuous self-reflection (muhasabah) and vigilance against complacency in faith.
